verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, but the evidence only documents single-item Graph API actions: put-content, createLink, version listing, and per-item addressing. Search and delta queries return many items at once, but they read or enumerate items rather than act on many items together. Looping over per-item APIs is a developer building block, not a documented bulk-operation capability, and the pack has no batch endpoint, multi-select bulk move/delete/share, or bulk tooling.
